module_summary: Bit-serial RISC-V ALU: a serial adder with registered carry, sign-aware compare with registered result, and boolean unit, OR-muxed onto rd by one-hot select.

anchors.name: result_add
anchors.why: Serial add/sub result bit from rs1 + op_b + carry; feeds rd mux and equality compare.

anchors.name: result_bool
anchors.why: Boolean xor/or/and result selected by i_bool_op, muxed onto rd.

anchors.name: result_slt
anchors.why: Set-less-than result: registered compare output on first bit, zeros elsewhere.

anchors.name: result_lt
anchors.why: Signed/unsigned less-than computed from sign-extended operands and adder carry.

anchors.name: result_eq
anchors.why: Running equality: zero sum bit AND previous compare state.

anchors.name: add_cy_r
anchors.why: Carry register held between serial bit cycles; preset to i_sub for subtraction.

anchors.name: cmp_r
anchors.why: Registered compare result carried across bits; used for eq chaining and slt.

anchors.name: i_rs1
anchors.why: Serial rs1 operand bit into adder, boolean unit and compare.

anchors.name: i_op_b
anchors.why: Serial operand B bit, inverted for subtraction.

anchors.name: o_rd
anchors.why: Serial rd result: OR of i_buf and selected ALU results.

anchors.name: i_buf
anchors.why: Shift/buffer register bit ORed directly into rd output.

anchors.name: o_cmp
anchors.why: Comparison result output (eq or lt) for branches; also latched into cmp_r.

anchors.name: i_rd_sel
anchors.why: One-hot select of add, slt or bool result onto rd.

anchors.name: i_en
anchors.why: Enables carry propagation and compare register update each serial cycle.

anchors.name: i_sub
anchors.why: Selects subtraction: inverts op_b and presets carry-in.

anchors.name: i_cmp_eq
anchors.why: Selects equality vs less-than as compare output.

anchors.name: i_cmp_sig
anchors.why: Selects signed comparison by enabling operand sign extension.

groups.name: Serial adder
groups.description: Bit-serial add/sub with carry register preset by i_sub.

groups.name: Comparator
groups.description: Eq/lt compare with registered result chained across bits; slt result.

groups.name: Boolean unit
groups.description: Xor/or/and of rs1 and op_b selected by i_bool_op.

groups.name: Result mux
groups.description: One-hot OR mux of ALU results and buffer bit onto rd.
